“'JUSTICE FOR ERIC SABER'

Justice is the call of relatives & supporters in the funeral march held to Manila North Cemetery for Eric Saber this Thursday, October 2.
Saber was a construction worker who was killed on Sept. 21 during the police dispersal of a protest in Mendiola.”
